defs.d: To arrive, come (to a place).
To come about; happen; come into being; arise.
defs.ex: It hath becomen so that many a man had to sterve.

defs.d: A vegetable with a nutritious, juicy, sweet root that is often orange in colour, Daucus carota, especially the subspecies sativus in the family Apiaceae.
A shade of orange similar to the flesh of most carrots (also called carrot orange).
To treat (an animal pelt) with a solution of mercuric nitrate as part of felt manufacture.
A piece of furniture, usually flat and soft, on which to rest or sleep.
defs.ex:
My cat often sleeps on my bed.
I keep a glass of water next to my bed when I sleep.

defs.d: A place, or flat surface or layer, on which something else rests or is laid.
defs.ex: The meats and cheeses lay on a bed of lettuce.

defs.d: Senses relating to a bed as a place for resting or sleeping.
Senses relating to a bed as a place or layer on which something else rests or is laid.
A collection of sheets of paper bound together to hinge at one edge, containing printed or written material, pictures, etc.
defs.ex: He was frustrated because he couldn't find anything about dinosaurs in the book.

defs.d: A long work fit for publication, typically prose, such as a novel or textbook, and typically published as such a bound collection of sheets, but now sometimes electronically as an e-book.
defs.ex: I have three copies of his first book.

defs.d: A formal, rhythmic way of walking, used especially by soldiers, bands and in ceremonies.
A political rally or parade
To walk with long, regular strides, as a soldier does.
To cause someone to walk somewhere.
The amount of bending that something undergoes when a force is applied to it; a tendency to yield under pressure; resilence.
defs.ex: There is no give in his dogmatic religious beliefs.

defs.d: (ditransitive) To move, shift, provide something abstract or concrete to someone or something or somewhere.
(ditransitive) To estimate or predict (a duration or probability) for (something).
defs.ex: I give it a 95% chance of success.

defs.d: A sports competition, especially for track and field (a track meet) or swimming (a swim meet).
A gathering of riders, horses and hounds for foxhunting; a field meet for hunting.
To make contact (with) while in proximity.
(Of groups) To come together.
One of two options on a true-or-false test.
defs.ex: The student received a failing grade for circling every true and false on her quiz.

defs.d: Untrue, not factual, factually incorrect.
Based on factually incorrect premises.
defs.ex: false legislation, false punishment

defs.d: In a dishonest and disloyal way; falsely.
An old musical note, equal to two longas, four breves, or eight semibreves.
Liberality, generosity.
Of considerable or relatively great size or extent.
defs.ex: Russia is a large country.   The fruit-fly has large eyes for its body size.   He has a large collection of stamps.

defs.d: Abundant; ample.
Before the wind.
The left side or direction.
The ensemble of left-wing political parties. Those holding left-wing views as a group.
defs.ex: The political left is holding too much power.

defs.d: The opposite of right; toward the west when one is facing north.
defs.ex: The left side.

defs.d: Pertaining to the political left.
On the left side.
Towards the left side.
defs.ex: Turn left at the corner.

defs.d: Any insect of the order Diptera; characterized by having two wings (except for some wingless species), also called true flies.
(non-technical) Especially, any of the insects of the family Muscidae, such as the common housefly (other families of Diptera include mosquitoes and midges).
A drawing showing technical details of a building, machine, etc., with unwanted details omitted, and often using symbols rather than detailed drawing to represent doors, valves, etc.
defs.ex: The plans for many important buildings were once publicly available.

defs.d: A set of intended actions, usually mutually related, through which one expects to achieve a goal.
defs.ex: He didn't really have a plan; he had a goal and a habit of control.

defs.d: To design (a building, machine, etc.).
defs.ex: The architect planned the building for the client.

defs.d: To create a plan for.
defs.ex: They jointly planned the project in phases, with good detail for the first month.

defs.d: One of the four major compass points, specifically 0°, directed toward the North Pole, and conventionally upwards on a map, abbreviated as N.
defs.ex: Minnesota is in the north of the USA.

defs.d: The up or positive direction.
defs.ex: Stock prices are heading north.

defs.d: To turn or move toward the north.
Of or pertaining to the north; northern.
defs.ex: He lived in north Germany.

defs.d: Toward the north; northward.
Repetition of an activity to improve a skill.
defs.ex: He will need lots of practice with the lines before he performs them.

defs.d: An organized event for the purpose of performing such repetition.
defs.ex: Being on a team is hard: you're always having to go to practice while everyone else is taking it easy.

defs.d: To repeat (an activity) as a way of improving one's skill in that activity.
defs.ex: You should practise playing piano every day.

defs.d: To repeat an activity in this way.
defs.ex: If you want to speak French well, you need to practise.

defs.d: At that time; then.

Introduces a comparison, and is associated with comparatives, and with words such as more, less, and fewer. Typically, it seeks to measure the force of an adjective or similar description between two predicates.
defs.ex: A player than whom none is more skillful.

defs.d: Used in comparisons, to introduce the basis of comparison.
defs.ex: she's taller than I am;  she found his advice more witty than helpful;  we have less work today than we had yesterday;  We had no choice than to return home

defs.d: (obsolete outside dialectal, usually used with for) Because; for.
A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.
The female of a pair of mated animals.
defs.ex: A new wife for the gander is introduced into the pen.

defs.d: (said of men) to marry
An adult female human.
(collective) All females collectively; womankind.
The act or style of writing.
The operation of storing data, as in memory or onto disk.
defs.ex: How many writes per second can this hard disk handle?

defs.d: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.
defs.ex: The pupil wrote his name on the paper.

defs.d: To be the author of (a book, article, poem, etc.).
defs.ex: My uncle writes newspaper articles for The Herald.

defs.d: In a way which is certain; with certainty.
Without doubt, surely.
defs.ex: That was certainly sweet of him.

defs.d: An option; a decision; an opportunity to choose or select something.
defs.ex: Do I have a choice of what color to paint it?

defs.d: The power to choose.
defs.ex: She didn't leave us much choice.

defs.d: Especially good or preferred.
defs.ex: It's a choice location, but you will pay more to live there.

defs.d: Careful in choosing; discriminating.
To conduct (oneself) well, or in a given way.
defs.ex: You need to behave yourself, young lady.

defs.d: To act, conduct oneself in a specific manner; used with an adverbial of manner.
defs.ex: He behaves like a child whenever she's around.

defs.d: The action of competing.
defs.ex: The competition for this job is strong.

defs.d: A contest for a prize or award.
defs.ex: The newspaper is featuring a competition to win a car.

defs.d: The skeletal joint which connects the foot with the leg; the uppermost portion of the foot and lowermost portion of the leg, which contain this skeletal joint.
To walk.
To cyclically angle the foot at the ankle while pedaling, to maximize the amount of work applied to the pedal during each revolution.
(manner) In a special manner; specially.
(focus) Particularly; to a greater extent than is normal.
The keeper of a personal journal, who writes in it regularly.
One whose occupation is journalism, originally only writing in the printed press.
(heading) Boundary, land within a boundary.
(heading) Characteristic, sign, visible impression.
To put a mark on (something); to make (something) recognizable by a mark; to label or write on (something).
defs.ex: to mark a box or bale of merchandise

defs.d: To leave a mark (often an undesirable or unwanted one) on (something).
defs.ex: See where this pencil has marked the paper.

defs.d: The people living within a political or geographical boundary.
defs.ex: The population of New Jersey will not stand for this!

defs.d: (by extension) The people with a given characteristic.
defs.ex: India has the third-largest population of English-speakers in the world.

defs.d: A substantial, often approximately cuboid, piece of any substance.
defs.ex: a block of ice

defs.d: A chopping block; cuboid base for cutting or beheading.
defs.ex: Anne Boleyn placed her head on the block and awaited her execution.

defs.d: To fill (something) so that it is not possible to pass.
defs.ex: The pipe is blocked.

defs.d: To prevent (something or someone) from passing.
defs.ex: You're blocking the road – I can't get through!

defs.d: The structural elements of a building or other constructed object.
defs.ex: Now that the frame is complete, we can start on the walls.

defs.d: Anything composed of parts fitted and united together; a fabric; a structure.
To fit, as for a specific end or purpose; make suitable or comfortable; adapt; adjust.
To construct by fitting or uniting together various parts; fabricate by union of constituent parts.
Situated in, or designed to be used in, or carried on within, the interior of a building.
defs.ex: These fireworks are not for indoor use!

defs.d: A kind of macro in source code that replaces one text string with another wherever it occurs.
To determine with precision; to mark out with distinctness; to ascertain or exhibit clearly.
defs.ex: the defining power of an optical instrument

defs.d: To settle, decide (an argument etc.)
To set free from restraint or danger.
defs.ex: deliver a captive from the prison

defs.d: (process) To do with birth.
A weakness or undesirable characteristic; a con.
defs.ex: The disadvantage to owning a food processor is that you have to store it somewhere.

defs.d: A setback or handicap.
defs.ex: My height is a disadvantage for reaching high shelves.

defs.d: To place at a disadvantage.
defs.ex: They fear it might disadvantage honest participants to allow automated entries.

defs.d: The act or process of punishing, imposing and/or applying a sanction.
A penalty to punish wrongdoing, especially for crime.
To undergo hardship.
defs.ex: Is anyone here afraid of suffering hardship?

defs.d: To feel pain.
defs.ex: At least he didn't suffer when he died in the car crash.

defs.d: An act of throwing.
An instance of throwing out a fishing line.
(physical) To move, or be moved, away.
To direct (one's eyes, gaze etc.).
Collectively, all the persons who live in a given house; a family including attendants, servants etc.; a domestic or family establishment.
A line of ancestry; a race or house.
Belonging to the same house and family.
Found in or having its origin in a home.
To launch a projectile.
To move or act quickly or suddenly.
An instance of shooting with a gun or other weapon.
defs.ex: Police are hunting the people who carried out the shootings last week.

defs.d: The sport or activity of firing a gun or other weapon.
defs.ex: I take part in shooting at the local archery club.

defs.d: The process of change from one form, state, style or place to another.
A word or phrase connecting one part of a discourse to another.
To make a transition.
To bring through a transition; to change.
defs.ex: The soldier was transitioned from a combat role to a strategic role.
